item.tib: gsang sngags spyi spungs kyi yig chung gnad sgron mdzes pa'i zur rgyan
item.coloph: de ltar bsnyen pa'i gzhi ma sgo dgu'i ting 'dzin gyi rim pa rnams/ mkhas grub rin po ches mdzad pa'i shog chung rnams brtsal (btsal) bas ma rnyed nas kho bos brtsams tshul ni/ deng sang lnga brgya'i 'dren pa rgyal tshabs che/ rin chen 'od kyis dbang chen cha lag tu/ bkod pa'i shog chung yan lag brgyad ldan mtsho/ dpe chas dben pa'i skom pas cher gdung tshe/ sel bar snyam ste ba tsha'i khron pa 'di/ skom gdung bdag 'dra slob ma'i dga' ston du/ bskyil bar byed po rgyal ba tshul khrims zhes/ kha byang dbang des rnam par rab dkar blos/ dben gnas g.yung drung ri khrod skyil bu ru/ 'bad pa 'di la dge tshogs mchis srid na/ bstan pa rin po che yi zhabs 'degs dang / 'gro kun rnam byang rgyu ru smin 'gyur cig/
